CustomField.label: External Template Id
CustomField.description: The Id of the active portwoodglobal__DocGen_Template__c record for the "Broker Snapshot External" template (the WT_BrokerSnapshotExternal.page equivalent — a trimmed field set, plus a Broker_Snapshot_External_Usage__c audit record on every generation). Set this after creating/uploading that template in the Portwood app — it is environment-specific (sandbox and production have different Ids for the same template).
